REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: High-impact approval is inferred only from reviewer-profile name substrings. The package therefore cannot prove that independent Sol and Opus reviewers approved a contract change.
FINDING: critical|scripts/factory-ng-provenance-validate.py|SOL/OPUS regexes accept arbitrary unregistered reviewer_profile labels without verifying immutable reviewer identity or resolved model|this permits high-impact acceptance without actual independent Sol and Opus approval
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Bind each review to an immutable review receipt containing registered profile, provider, resolved model, attempt, and digest; validate both receipts against a trusted profile registry while retaining distinctness checks.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: A high-impact record with distinct accepted reviews named attacker-sol-review@1 and attacker-opus-review@1, plus distinct IDs/digests, passes the schema and validator despite providing no evidence that Sol or Opus performed either review.
